recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray #E8E8E8.
2. Draw the top rule: a thin horizontal crimson #C00000 line spanning the full slide width at ~5% of slide height; fill the narrow strip above the line (from the slide's top edge down to the rule) with white #FFFFFF, so the rule separates a white top band from the gray body below.
3. Place the title 'Filters parameters' horizontally centered (~30-70% width) at ~6-18% height, in bold Arial/Helvetica-like sans-serif, ~40pt, crimson #C00000, mixed case.
4. Place the formula box: a white #FFFFFF rectangle with a solid medium-blue #3333CC border ~2pt thick, spanning ~9-91% of slide width and ~20-42% of slide height in the upper-middle band.
5. Inside the formula box add line 1, left-aligned, black #000000, serif (Times New Roman-like) ~20-22pt: 'Number of parameters for different filters applied to same location in the image'.
6. Directly below, add line 2, same font/size/alignment: '= Filter size (2-D) * Number of channels (K)  * number of different filters' with 'Filter size (2-D)' in bold red #C00000, 'Number of channels (K)' in bold blue #0000CC, 'number of different filters' in bold green #009900, and the leading '=' plus both '*' asterisks in black #000000 (preserve the double space between '(K)' and the second '*').
7. Directly below, add line 3, same font/size/alignment: '= 7*7  * 3  * 5  =735' with '7*7' in bold red #C00000, '3' in bold blue #0000CC, '5' in bold green #009900, and the remaining characters ('=', '*', '=735') in black #000000.
8. Place the diagram canvas: a white #FFFFFF rectangle with a solid red #C00000 border ~2pt thick, spanning ~18-85% of slide width and ~45-95% of slide height, horizontally centered in the lower-middle band.
9. On the left side of the canvas, draw the image-patch slab: a 3D parallelepiped with a parallelogram front face filled tan/brown #C08040 and darker brown #8B4513 top and side faces/edges.
10. Annotate the image slab in a casual handwritten-style font, black #000000: 'RGB' above the slab; '3 dims' at its top-left with a short black arrow pointing to the slab's depth edge; '7' along its left vertical edge; '7' along its bottom edge.
11. Draw 5 thin dashed black #000000 horizontal lines extending rightward from the right face of the slab, indicating the 7x7 receptive field.
12. Place a handwritten-style black #000000 'X' (multiplication sign) to the right of the dashed lines, between the image slab and the filter stack.
13. Draw the filter stack at the center of the canvas: five overlapping 3D parallelepiped slabs, smaller than the image slab, colored left-to-right #00BFBF (cyan), #00A000 (green), #FF0000 (red), #FFFF00 (yellow), #800080 (purple), each with a thin black #000000 outline.
14. Annotate the filter stack in the handwritten font, black #000000: '7' above the stack; '7' between slabs at mid-height; '7' at the right side of the purple slab; '3' at the bottom-left of the cyan slab beside a tiny pencil icon drawn as a simple black line doodle (together indicating 7x7x3 per filter).
15. To the right of the filter stack, place a light-blue #6699FF '=' sign.
16. Further right, draw a horizontal row of five filled circles ~0.4 in in diameter with thin black #000000 outlines, colored left-to-right #00BFBF, #00A000, #FF0000, #FFFF00, #800080 (the 5 output units / feature maps).
17. At the bottom center of the canvas, add handwritten-style black #000000 text '735 weights' and draw five thin black #000000 arrows fanning upward from this text, one to each of the five filter slabs.
18. Do NOT recreate the solid black strip along the very bottom edge of the source frame (it is the video-player progress bar, not slide content), and add no slide number, footer, or watermark (none is present on the slide).
